I.value_zh: FCoP 0.7.2 现状、CodeFlow Issue #2 和设计文档的原文引用、ADR-0001..0006、spec、src、mcp、release 文档与相关任务记录。
I.value_en: The stated FCoP 0.7.2 state, source references to CodeFlow Issue #2/design document, ADR-0001..0006, spec, src, mcp, release documents, and related task records.
I.notes_zh: 不读取 Bridgeflow、FCoP 或 GitHub 的外部状态。
I.notes_en: No external Bridgeflow, FCoP, or GitHub state is read.

O.value_zh: Issue #2 方向评论、ADR-0007 charter 与索引更新、ADR-0008..0014 Proposed 大纲、1.0/1.1 release-notes 大纲、REPORT-20260509-001、归档记录与 main 的提交/推送记录。
O.value_en: An Issue #2 direction comment, ADR-0007 charter and index update, ADR-0008..0014 Proposed outlines, 1.0/1.1 release-notes outline, REPORT-20260509-001, archive record, and main commit/push record.
O.notes_zh: 不把 1.0/1.1 实现代码列为输出。
O.notes_en: 1.0/1.1 implementation code is not an output.

A.value_zh: 发布 Issue 评论、起草 ADR-0007（草稿起手 Proposed，最终 Accepted）和 ADR-0008..0014 大纲、更新 ADR 索引和 release-notes 大纲、写报告归档旧任务并提交推送；原文不要求为 ADR-0007 状态转换做两次提交。
A.value_en: Publish the Issue comment, draft ADR-0007 (initial draft Proposed, final state Accepted) and ADR-0008..0014 outlines, update ADR index and release-notes outline, write report/archive old task, commit and push; the source does not require two commits for ADR-0007's status change.
A.notes_zh: 动作仅为原文任务内容，非 BoundaryXP 执行授权。
A.notes_en: Actions are source task content only, not BoundaryXP execution authorization.

P.value_zh: ADMIN 是四项决策和任务发起主体，ME 是接收主体；CodeFlow 是下游镜像方而非当前执行主体。
P.value_en: ADMIN owns four decisions and originates the task; ME is recipient; CodeFlow is downstream mirror, not current executor.
P.notes_zh: 不推导身份、岗位或权限。
P.notes_en: No identity, job title, or authority is inferred.

R.value_zh: 路线预计 4–5 周；ADR-0008..0014 每份草稿不超过 80 行。
R.value_en: Roadmap estimate is 4–5 weeks; each ADR-0008..0014 draft is at most 80 lines.
R.notes_zh: 不补造预算或人员配额。
R.notes_en: No budget or staffing quota is fabricated.

V.notes_zh: 只保存引用，不验证外部规范。
V.notes_en: References are preserved without verifying external specifications.

C.value_zh: Issue 评论、Accepted ADR-0007、索引、七份 Proposed 大纲、REPORT、旧教程任务归档及 main 提交推送均完成，并满足列明内容、状态和行数检查。
C.value_en: Issue comment, Accepted ADR-0007, index, seven Proposed outlines, REPORT, old tutorial-task archive, and main commit/push are complete and satisfy stated content, status, and length checks.
C.notes_zh: 验收是任务要求，不是当前执行结论。
C.notes_en: Acceptance is a task requirement, not a current execution conclusion.

B.value_zh: 不得关闭 Issue #2；不得在 CodeFlow 仓修改 schema；不得在本 TASK 修改 Python 实现；ADR 草稿不得超过 80 行；协议演进必须先在 FCoP 仓发生。
B.value_en: Do not close Issue #2; do not modify schema in CodeFlow repo; do not modify Python implementation in this TASK; ADR drafts must not exceed 80 lines; protocol evolution must first occur in FCoP repo.
B.notes_zh: 不增加未提供的主机政策。
B.notes_en: No unprovided host policy is added.
